description: This file defines a JavaScript class for handling file uploads with features like image preview, reset, and clear functionalities, integrated as a jQuery plugin.

classes.name: Fileupload
classes.description: A class managing file upload UI interactions, including image preview, clearing, and resetting upload fields.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for file input change, form reset, and remove button click.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Handles file selection, updates preview if image, or displays filename.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the file input, resets preview and classes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the upload field to its original state.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers the file input click event.
